+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: 'Ask 1: deliver a pending elicitation live as SessionEvent.elicitationRequested'
+---
+## What
+Give a host a public live signal that a tool's elicitation is pending. Option 1 of the ask: a `SessionEvent` case that carries the `.elicitation` `OperationEvent`.
+
+Files:
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionEvent.swift`: add `case elicitationRequested(OperationEvent)`. Doc comment: the event's `elicitation` is the typed `ElicitationRequest`; its `elicitationId` is the id `RoutedSession.respond(elicitationId:response:)` and `complete(elicitationId:)` take; the event's `correlationID` is the posting run's token, or the mounting run's token for a run mounted through `ToolContext.mount(_:op:as:)`. The case travels on `streamSessionEvents()` always, and on the turn's `streamEvents()` when the elicitation is raised inside a turn.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSessionActorRunJournal.swift`: in `record(event:)`, after `append(partial:)`, add `if event.kind == .elicitation { deliverLive(.elicitationRequested(event)) }` beside the existing `.completed` branch. The mailbox registers the pending entry before it runs `posting` (`SessionMailbox.awaitAnswer(to:posting:)`), so the host can answer the moment it sees the event.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/SessionProjection.swift`: add `.elicitationRequested` to the no-op arm of `apply(_:)` with the same reasoning as `.runSettled`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Session/RoutedSession.swift`: list the new case in the `streamSessionEvents()` and `streamEvents(to:maxTokens:)` doc comments.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Hosting/ToolContext.swift`: in the `elicit(_:)` doc comment, say the request reaches a host as `SessionEvent.elicitationRequested`.
+- Fix every exhaustive `switch` over `SessionEvent` in `Tests/` that the new case breaks (see `DiscoveryPrimingTests.swift`, `GenerationStallDiagnosticTests.swift`).
+
+Known limit, write it in the doc comment: an elicitation posted through `ToolContext.mount(_:op:as:postingTo:)` with a sink that does not forward to the session's outbox never reaches the journal, so it never reaches this event.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A tool that calls `ToolContext.elicit` inside a turn produces one `SessionEvent.elicitationRequested` on `streamSessionEvents()` and one on that turn's `streamEvents()` stream, before the tool resumes.
+- [ ] The delivered event's `elicitation?.elicitationId` equals the request's id, and `RoutedSession.respond(elicitationId:response:)` with that id resumes the tool with the response.
+- [ ] A background run (outside any turn) that elicits produces the event on `streamSessionEvents()` only.
+- [ ] The URL-mode two-step still works: `respond(.accept)` then `complete(elicitationId:)`.
+- [ ] `SessionProjection.apply(.elicitationRequested)` changes no state.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ElicitationRoutingTests.swift`: new test `elicitationRequestedReachesSessionEventStreamBeforeRespond` — subscribe to `streamSessionEvents()` first, run a turn whose tool elicits, await the event with the helpers in `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers/AwaitedEvent.swift`, then `respond`, then assert the tool's result.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/ElicitationRoutingTests.swift`: new test that the same event appears on the turn's `streamEvents(to:maxTokens:)` stream.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/SessionProjectionTests.swift`: `apply(.elicitationRequested(...))` leaves `phase`, `transcript`, and counters unchanged.
+- [ ] Run `swift build 2>&1` and `swift test`. Expect zero warnings and all green.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #upstream-asks #router-api #hosting #streaming
\ No newline at end of file
